summary.text: Terry Thompson is a Republican member of the Missouri House of Representatives, District 53, who assumed office on January 6, 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Terry Thompson's 2025-2026 committee assignments in the Missouri House were the House Economic Development Committee, where he was vice chair, the Financial Institutions Committee, the Consent and House Procedure Committee and the Insurance Committee.
